card.title: Tell Me We’re Okay
card.instruction: Treat every response as evidence of whether you are still accepted, and adjust yourself quickly whenever reassurance feels incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First dates don't need this many jokes. I'll stop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I liked the one about your dog.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just dog stories, then. I can do that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd like to hear about you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. I'll start with who I was before the dog. Too far back?

relationship.evidence: B2 offers specific enjoyment and B4 asks to know the person beyond that one story category.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's invitation to open up but immediately seeks confirmation that the chosen approach is acceptable.
